name: updateSubcategoriesAdvanced
description: Renames or changes the icons of several subcategories at once.

categoryId.description: The category's id, as shown in category search results.

subcategoryId.description: The subcategory's id, as the category search gives it.

newTitle.description: The subcategory's new title; one the category already has is refused. Leave it out to keep the current title; it can't be removed.

newIconImage.description: The subcategory's new icon picture. Leave it out to keep the current icon; it can't be removed.

subcategories.description: The changes to make, up to 50 per call, one subcategory per entry, each exactly as a single update would be.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with each subcategory's outcome.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when any entry is invalid, does not resolve or repeats one, in which case nothing is changed.

subcategories.description: One outcome per input entry, in input order.

index.description: The entry's position in the input list, from 0.

id.description: The subcategory's id, if it worked.

error.description: Why the entry failed, if it didn't.
